messages:
lauren: heads up — canary rollout of awq-actq + group_size=64 for phantom-13B is flipping outputs intermittently on streaming requests, seen on two customer sim jobs and staging smoke. logs attached below.

lauren: snippet:```
2026-03-19T21:12:43Z WARN inference: decode mismatch seed=4202 group=64 act_q=1
input_id=ck_0032 sample_idx=7 baseline_hash=0x9b2a6 got=0x7c1d3
kv_cache_prefill=true prefix_len=48
stacktrace: runner:decode -> awq_group_decode -> softmax_overflow_check
```

anand: thanks — can you paste the minimal repro command you used for the canary? :eyes:

lauren: repro: `./serve_canary --model phantom-13b --quant awq --group 64 --act-quant true --batch 1 --warmup 10`
also noticed a burst after longer prefixes (>40 tokens).

kai: quick hypothesis: group=64 + act quant interacts badly with the prefix cache warmstart path. we've seen boundary flips when KV prefill + large group cause numeric accumulation. try disabling prefill: `AWQ_KV_PREFILL=0` or reduce group to 32.

mike: fwiw eval numbers from yesterday run on hhq-bench:
- FP16 baseline: exact match 0.892
- AWQ g64 actq=on: 0.867 (drop ~2.5%)
- AWQ g64 actq=off: 0.886 (drop ~0.6%)
- AWQ g32 actq=on: 0.881 (drop ~1.1%)
so act quant seems to be the bigger hit at g64.

sara: can we repro deterministically? if seed controls it we should be able to add more asserts in runner.

lauren: not fully deterministic — seed changes sometimes flip, sometimes not. suspect partial non-determinism from fused kernels + scaling. also observed a variant where outputs diverged only for streaming chunk boundary.

anand: plan: 1) run targeted canary with `group=32, actq=on` and `group=64, actq=off` to isolate which knob is worse. 2) run with `AWQ_KV_PREFILL=0` to see warmstart impact. 3) add extra floating sanity check in decode that logs pre-softmax norm if diff>threshold. 4) if reproduces, pin a quick rollback to actq=off on canary.

kai: adding a quick env toggle patch:```diff
--- a/serve/runtime/env.go
+++ b/serve/runtime/env.go
@@ -12,6 +12,9 @@
 func init() {
+    // temporary: disable kv prefill in canary to triage numeric drift
+    os.Setenv("AWQ_KV_PREFILL","${AWQ_KV_PREFILL:-1}")
 }
```
(small PR incoming)

mike: ran the two isolation runs: g32+actq=on gives much fewer mismatches in 2k samples (2 vs 43), g64+actq=off gives 6 mismatches. so group size looks amplifying the actq error.

ci-bot: `canary-tests/phantom-13b` completed — g32+actq:on: 2 failures / 2000 (0.1%), g64+actq:on: 43/2000 (2.15%), g64+actq:off: 6/2000 (0.3%). Logs: http://ci.internal/canary/2163005123

sara: thanks ci-bot. i'd recommend we keep actq off for canary until we have a numeric fix or a quant-calibration pass. actq seems to exacerbate tail failure modes.

lauren: Agreed. I'm going to pin the canary to `act_q=false` and roll g32 for perf parity checks. I'll run a focused calibration sweep on the act-quant scaling factors tomorrow morning.

anand: action items: lauren to pin canary + run calibration sweep; kai to land kv-prefill toggle PR for quick triage; mike to run longer 50k-sample overnight with g32+actq:on to get confidence numbers; sara to add gating rule to prevent auto-promotion if mismatch_rate > 0.5%.

lauren: assigning: @lauren (owner), @kai (kv-prefill PR), @mike (stress run), @sara (gating). aiming to have results and decision in the morning. :thumbsup:

mike: noted. starting long-run now. will drop logs to the canary folder.

kai: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/awq/kv-prefill-toggle (small). cc @lauren for review.

lauren: thanks all. one more note — we should add a metric for "stream-chunk-boundary-flips" to Console (per-route) so we can catch these earlier in the next model bring-up. filing a ticket.

sara: filed UI ticket (#INT-6421) and added a quick telemetry check in eval harness.

lauren: i'll update the rollout plan after morning runs. if numbers look good we'll try g32 + actq:on canary for 4h then decision.

anand: perfect. keep the rollback path ready. :rocket:
